lastCompletedStory.title: Swap install.sh destinations by atomic rename from a staged temp inside INSTALL_DIR

nextStoryContext: install.sh now stages one mktemp-in-INSTALL_DIR temp per NAME (gateship, gship), preps it fully (cp, chmod +x, darwin quarantine strip), then `mv -f STAGED DEST`. STAGED="" is declared before the download section; the pre-existing EXIT trap at :98 (already covering TMP_BIN+TMP_SUMS) was extended in place (not joined by a second trap) to `rm -f "${TMP_BIN}" "${TMP_SUMS}" ${STAGED:+"${STAGED}"}` -- the bash-3.2-safe scalar form, not an array. Two new durable legs live in test/install-sh.test.ts: 'running binary' (compiles a real bun build --compile fixture, runs it as a live background process reading env CAM497_MARKER_PATH/CAM497_SLEEP_MS to hand-shake readiness via a marker file before install.sh runs, then asserts install exit 0 + live pid survives (process.kill(pid,0)) + a fresh exec of the resulting file still exits 0) and 'atomic swap' (installs twice into the same INSTALL_DIR, asserts the inode changed between runs, the binary stays executable, and no dot-file staging litter is left). Both are falsifiable: swept red against main's install.sh via the new GATESHIP_TEST_INSTALL_SH env override (defaults to the repo copy) -- see the AC7 oracle for the exact reviewer-reproducible command. GOTCHA for any future story that compiles a bun build --compile test fixture on THIS toolchain (macOS 26.3.1 / bun 1.3.13): re-signing a trivial single/few-module fixture with `codesign --force --sign -` fails nondeterministically with 'main executable failed strict validation' (upstream oven-sh/bun#7208), even though this repo's own real multi-hundred-module index.ts signs fine on the same machine. The fixture in this story deliberately stays unsigned (install.sh itself never codesigns, only strips the darwin quarantine bit) -- verified manually that an unsigned ad-hoc bun-compile binary run directly out of a user-owned /tmp dir reproduces the exact running-image-poisoning symptom (live pid survives kill -0, fresh re-exec dies rc=137) with zero signing needed. Full writeup in scripts/cam/patterns.md.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Docs confirm bun build --compile embeds a full runtime and recommend `codesign --deep --force -vvvv --sign <identity> --entitlements entitlements.plist` for a real distribution signing identity (unrelated to this story's ad-hoc/unsigned test-fixture path, which install.sh itself never performs). No documented gotcha about scratch-file location or nondeterministic ad-hoc re-sign failures on trivial fixtures; that nondeterminism was verified empirically and recorded in scripts/cam/patterns.md instead of being an official-docs mismatch.
